report_title: 金門縣縣定古蹟黃厝洪氏古厝修復及再利用計畫
executing_institution: 國立金門大學戰地史蹟與閩南建築研究中心
reading_scope: Cover, spatial form text, first/second-floor plans, guoshui/side court table and photos, porch/stair construction table and photos.

text_measurements.note: Text says 13 and notes unequal rises/depths; not used as a generated stair count or reconciled with plan numbering.

plan_outline_check.scope: Overall plan proportions only; the original drawing scale bar and local room dimensions have not been independently measured.

phase_distinctions: The original core is a one-luo four-projection compound; the right-side hulong tower was added around the 1920s.
The front hulong rooms were joined and widened in the 1970s and their terrace roof was replaced.
The main core was altered for modern use in 2013. Current partitions are not silently treated as original fabric.
implemented_relationships: Independent side entrance, narrow court, inward-facing porch, covered cross passage.
Lower and upper court floor levels remain distinct editable geometry.
not_reconstructed: Actual Hong-house geometry, room names/orientation, later tower, lofts and staircase.
Surveyed masonry, timber joints, ornaments, closed modern doors and structural performance.
